subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should fallback transition and fallback-cleared notices be hidden by default in every group and channel room while remaining visible in direct chats?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically, but choosing a global cross-channel visibility policy for operational diagnostics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Suppress In All Rooms
options.body: Adopt the proposed privacy default across channels while preserving state and lifecycle diagnostics and proving direct-chat behavior remains unchanged.

options.title: Limit By Channel
options.body: Apply suppression only to explicitly approved channel implementations, accepting channel-specific policy and documentation.

options.title: Keep Current Visibility
options.body: Continue delivering fallback notices in rooms and address sensitive error wording through sanitization instead.

recommendation.title: Suppress In All Rooms
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed privacy default across channels while preserving state and lifecycle diagnostics and proving direct-chat behavior remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core, cross-channel product-policy choice rather than an implementation-only decision.
